text:
new-hires

Jordan: hey team — first day. running the onboarding-skel repo but hitting a few blockers: asdf won't install node 20, brew complains about openssl, docker gives permission denied on container sockets, and I can't find where to put my REDWOOD_API_KEY. any quick pointers? @devex @it-ops
Sasha: welcome! pinging @Taylor (devex) for the asdf/brew bits. what's your machine model?
Jordan: MacBook Pro (Apple Silicon, 2023) — macOS 14.4. using zsh and the onboarding-skel dotfiles.
Taylor (devex): hey @Jordan — common combo. try these steps:
```bash
# macOS Apple Silicon brew path + openssl
brew install openssl@1.1
export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"
# asdf node plugin + install (import keys first)
asdf plugin-add nodejs || true
# later: bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring
asdf install nodejs 20.5.0
```
Also run the onboarding-skel postinstall: `./scripts/postinstall` — it symlinks dotfiles and sets up hooks.
Jordan: tried openssl@3 already and brew errored 'can't find libssl'. postinstall fails when it tries to write to /usr/local/bin (permission denied). docker still says permission denied when I try `docker exec`.
Leo: on macs with Apple Silicon brew is under /opt/homebrew, don't change root /usr/local. Make sure your PATH has /opt/homebrew/bin before /usr/bin. For Docker Desktop on mac, install the app from docker.com and open it once to accept permissions. If you see socket perms in a Linux VM or CI, `sudo chown $USER:staff /var/run/docker.sock` often fixes local dev.
```bash
# example for socket fix (local dev VM)
sudo chown $(whoami):staff /var/run/docker.sock
```
Jordan: chown fixed the docker socket, thanks. node install still failing during GPG key import — asdf plugin step errors out.
Priya: for nodejs plugin keyring try this (it mirrors asdf-nodejs docs):
```bash
bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring || 
# fallback via curl if the script errors
curl -sSLo- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs/master/bin/import-release-team-keyring | bash
asdf install nodejs 20.5.0
```
That worked for me on a fresh macbook.
Jordan: that imported keys and node installed cleanly. last question: where do I set REDWOOD_API_KEY locally? I don't want creds in repo.
Taylor (devex): use direnv + .envrc and keep the .env in .gitignore, or use 1Password CLI for ephemeral tokens. We also have a docs page (onboarding keys) and a Vault-backed flow for longer-lived service creds. I'll DM the Vault steps.
devex-bot: Welcome Jordan! You were added to #new-hires and granted read/write access to onboarding-skel and the internal wiki. See the onboarding checklist: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/checklist
Jordan: awesome — thanks everyone. postinstall ran, devcontainer builds, will open a tiny PR to clarify the README step about PATH. :tada:
